title: Paloma and the Scholarship
author: Dominic Joubert
blurb: Elodie Almeida, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
